newsitem.title: USA: Tribune Co classifieds lead Q2 publishing growth.
newsitem.headline: Tribune Co classifieds lead Q2 publishing growth.

text.p: Tribune Co said Friday that classified advertising led revenue growth in its publishing group in the second quarter.

"In broadcasting, the integration of the Renaissance acquisition continues to go very well ... Looking forward, Tribune has very strong cash flow to support profitable growth," said chief executive John Madigan.

The diversified media company reported second-quarter net income excluding non-recurring items was $93 million, up from $84 million in 1996. Second quarter consolidated revenues increased to $720 million from $642 million in 1996.
"The improvement was due primarily to higher operating profit from publishing as well as broadcasting and entertainment, partially offset by higher net interest expense," Tribune said.

On a segment basis, Tribune said second-quarter operating profit from broadcasting and entertainment was up 23 percent to $81 million; operating profit from publishing was up 27 percent to $92 million; and operating profit from education was $11 million, down from $14 million in 1996.
